alex (sec): Heads-up: scheduled pen-test Wed 2025-08-20 14:00 UTC. Need a short, auditable readroom plan: ephemeral KMS grants, evidence S3 path, and a pre-window SIEM smoke. Who volunteers to own the evidence bundle?
rhea (sec-ops): I can. Will produce presigned S3 + manifest + SHA256. Prefer path s3://pt-evidence/{engagement}/. Will list required CloudTrail/ALB/APP logs.
jordan (infra): For KMS, we'll create a dedicated key with kms-proxy role that limits to Encrypt/Decrypt and GenerateDataKey. Role assumes via STS with 2h TTL. Can shorten to 4h for safety, but we can make it configurable.
maya (sre): We should run a T-2h and T-15m SIEM ingestion smoke. I can script the verification and post results to this thread. Also will enable extra audit verbosity for the window only.
alex (sec): Good. Also require RBAC guardrails: assessor role must be audit-only and have no IAM:PassRole or console logins. No broad service account wildcards.
jordan (infra): Agreed. We'll generate explicit service account ARNs. Jordan: will post terraform diff for ephemeral roles by EOD Mon.
rhea (sec-ops): Proposed remediation SLAs: critical = 48h, high = 7d, medium = 21d, low = 45d. Include rollback runbook for criticals.
release-bot: PT ticket created ENG-PT-2025-241 scope: staging + selected prod read endpoints. Window: 2025-08-20T14:00:00Z - 2025-08-20T18:00:00Z.
maya (sre): I'll attach the smoke script and SIEM query. Also will tag traces with pt_engagement_id for filtering.
rhea (sec-ops): Action items: (1) presigned path + manifest (owner: rhea) by Mon EOD; (2) terraform PR for roles & TTLs (owner: jordan) by Mon EOD; (3) SIEM smoke runbook (owner: maya) by Tue AM.
alex (sec): Also set evidence retention to 90d and lock object-level permissions. After window, roles auto-revoke. We'll keep this thread for retest scheduling.
rhea (sec-ops): Adding checklist: manifest.json includes file list, sha256s, signer, timestamp. Will publish link once ready.
jordan (infra): Sample policy snippet I'll include in PR: allow kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:ACCOUNT:key/pt-key.
maya (sre): Noted. I'll run a dryrun tomorrow for the smoke and report back.
alex (sec): Thanks everyone. If blockers surface, escalate to @oncall.
